{{Quote|My life for you, my loyalty to the Empire.|Lord Cytharat|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Cytharat''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My men are dead. I am alone against many&hellip; but I know my duty. Lowering the heat shield.|Cytharat faces his death|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Cytharat was brought out of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] by [[Darth Malgus]], who would later [[New Empire|betray the Empire]]; despite his association with Malgus, Cytharat remained with the real Empire, and continued to serve to atone for his master's treachery. During the [[Conquest of Makeb#The Empire makes its move|Empire's campaign]] against the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on the planet [[Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], Cytharat served as tactical advisor to the support team sent by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]] to secure the planet's supply of the rare substance [[isotope-5]]. He arrived at the orbital docking ring of [[Gravity Hook Seven]] along with support team leader [[Katha Niar]] and Captain [[Hanthor]] after the gravity hook was captured by the ground team.<ref name="Pierce" />

When the Hutts' stored supply of isotope-5 was discovered in a fortress codenamed "[[Stronghold One]]," the ground team moved in to capture the vault with Cytharat leading troops in support to ensure the [[InterStellar Regulators]] did not send in reinforcements. However, the vault was found to be empty, the isotope installed in an army of war droids by order of [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]]. Outnumbered and outgunned, the ground team was forced to pull out; looking for possible solutions, [[New Thinking Division]] scientist [[Nadrin Tro]] sent Cytharat and his team schematics for the stronghold's heat shields; Cytharat and the ground team would work in unison to disable it and flood the vault with magma, but at the cost of Cytharat and his men.

{{GameDS}}
The ground team ultimately went with Nadrin's plan, and Cytharat accepted his fate as a matter of duty. With his men killed and surrounded by isotope-5 war droids, Cytharat lowered the heat shield and filled the security center with magma, taking the war droids with him.<ref name="Thunder" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Cytharat_faces_death.png|thumb|right|180px|Cytharat's final moments]]
Because of his Sith [[Blood/Legends|blood]], Cytharat had decidedly non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] features, such as glowing [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], crimson skin, pointy [[Bone/Legends|cheekbones]] and a set of tendrils hanging down from his chin and temples. Cytharat had [[Raven/Legends|raven]] black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], which he kept cropped and slicked back, and he wore a piece of [[Gold/Legends|golden]] jewelry on the bridge of his [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. His hands, however, had five fingers, while those of the then-extinct pure Sith had only three.<ref name="Pierce" />

Cytharat professed unwavering loyalty to the Empire in general and to his superiors. Despite having been Malgus' protégé, he did not approve of his treachery.<ref name="Pierce" /> In addition to his reliability, Lord Cytharat was also a skilled tactician, and he would always keep his cool, even in crisis situations or when badly wounded.<ref name="Thunder" /> In regards to romance and sexuality, Cytharat was only interested in other men.<ref name="Romance">In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Cytharat can only be romanced by [[Gender/Legends|male]] player characters.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cytharat first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a digital expansion released in [[2013]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

Cytharat's fate is determined on the player's conversation choices; the article assumes that the dark side option is canon. The alternative light side option is to order Cytharat to rendezvous with the player at the security station; he and his men will be wounded, but they will survive and be sent back to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for recovery. After the Archon is defeated in the mission "Revenge of the Archon", Captain Hanthor will mention to Darth Marr in the debriefing that Cytharat is nearly recovered and will return from Dromund Kaas soon.<ref name="Revenge">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Revenge of the Archon|Makeb}}</ref>

When ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' was released, Cytharat became the first male same-sex romance option in series through a storyline limited to Makeb.<ref name="TheWrap">{{WebCite|url=https://www.thewrap.com/lgbt-star-wars-characters-a-brief-history|text=LGBT 'Star Wars' Characters: A Brief History|author=Owen, Phil|date=2016-03-10|work=[[Wikipedia:TheWrap|''TheWrap'']]|archivedate=20200924141041}}</ref> Cytharat is portrayed as a gay man; only male player characters can begin an ongoing flirtation with him. The flirtations will only culminate in a kiss if the light side option is taken and Cytharat lives.<ref name="Romance" />
